metrics.name: Corpus token count
metrics.definition: Sum of token ids over all sentences in the language slice

metrics.name: Token premium
metrics.definition: CTC(lang) / CTC(eng_Latn) for the same tokenizer
metrics.reference: Arnett et al. (crosslingual token premiums / CTC on parallel text)

metrics.name: Token fertility
metrics.cjk_note: For zho_Hans also report tokens_per_char; do not compare whitespace fertility to Latin langs

metrics.name: Characters per token
metrics.definition: count of non-whitespace Unicode code points after NFKC / CTC

metrics.name: Single Token Retention Rate
metrics.definition: (# whitespace words encoded as exactly 1 token) / (# whitespace words)
metrics.cjk_note: Not reported for zho_Hans; use STFR and chars/token instead

metrics.name: Single Token Fragmentation Rate
metrics.definition: (# tokens whose decoded surface form has length 1) / CTC
metrics.note: Named STFR to avoid confusion with type-token ratio (TTR)

grapheme_cluster.name: Unicode extended grapheme clusters (UAX #29)
grapheme_cluster.note: Stand-in when multilingual G2P/IPA is not resource-feasible; full IPA+ipatok not in scope for all langs

optional_english_ipa_ipatok.note: Optional one-language phonic sketch only if espeak-ng IPA for English is easy

decision_rule.clause_a: non-English language with token_premium >= 2.0 on >= 2 frontier tokenizers (o200k, glm, llama, qwen)
decision_rule.clause_b: fertility (or tokens/char for CJK) >= 2x English on the same tokenizer for complex/non-Latin languages
